name: at-safari
description: Operate explicitly assigned Safari tabs through a local MCP bridge with human handoff.

interface.shortDescription: Use assigned Safari tabs in the background.
interface.longDescription: Connect the at-safari Safari extension to local MCP tools. Reuse signed-in tabs, read pages, perform bounded DOM actions, and pause for human takeover. Requires the companion macOS app. Alpha: no screenshots or trusted native input.
interface.defaultPrompt: Connect at-safari and show the Safari tabs I have assigned.
